name: Sneak
description: Move quietly, hide from enemies and sense nearby threats.
training: Move while sneaking on the ground, or sneak near enemy mobs.
Land melee hits on enemy mobs while sneaking. Attacking players does not train Sneak.
rules: Sneak for three seconds to hide beyond your concealment range. Standing or using Ambush reveals you; damage keeps you visible for 15 seconds.
Threat Sense can spot hidden players within 20 blocks. Only the player using it sees them.
Speed bonuses affect sneaking, not walking or sprinting. Minecraft’s speed limits still apply.

traits.name: Concealment I
traits.description: While concealed, your body, equipment and name disappear for players and mobs farther than 25 blocks. Damage reveals you for 15 seconds. Players at the threshold can still see you.

traits.name: Soft Landing
traits.description: Take 25% less fall damage when sneaking on landing from a fall of up to 20 blocks.

traits.name: Concealment II
traits.description: The visibility boundary moves inward to 20 blocks. Players farther away cannot see your rendered entity while concealed.

traits.name: Pickpocket
traits.description: Sneak behind an unaware humanoid enemy within 3 blocks. Right-click with an empty main hand and stay still for two seconds. Default reward: one gold nugget, once per mob. Players cannot be pickpocketed.

traits.name: Ambush
traits.description: Deal 25% extra base melee damage from behind eligible unaware enemies or players. Requires no recent combat between the pair; a 15-second cooldown and reveal follow. Protection rules still apply.

traits.name: Concealment III
traits.description: Your concealment boundary improves to 15 blocks.

traits.name: Night Vision
traits.description: Sneak continuously for more than three seconds to gain night vision. Standing ends the effect.

traits.name: Concealment IV
traits.description: Your concealment boundary improves to 12.5 blocks.

traits.name: Threat Sense
traits.description: After more than three seconds sneaking, see private outlines of enemies and players within 20 blocks, including through walls. Standing ends sensing.

traits.name: Master Concealment
traits.description: Your concealment boundary reaches 10 blocks. Your accumulated sneak-speed bonus remains +200%.

traits.name: Shadow title
traits.description: Unlock the Shadow chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Farming
description: Grow better harvests and unlock ore trees that produce resources.
training: Harvest fully grown crops yourself, including wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa and sweet berries.
Harvest naturally grown pumpkins and melons. Planting, tilling, placed fruit and automatic farms do not train Farming.
rules: Crop bonuses need you online and within 32 blocks of crops you planted. Normal light, water and soil requirements still apply.
Growth boosts help crops grow sooner, but harvest times vary. Double harvests do not double seeds or XP.
Ore trees produce resources, not Farming XP. They work in loaded chunks even while you’re offline, with up to 10 registered trees per type.

traits.name: Cultivation
traits.description: Ordinary levels alternate growth and double-produce chance, each reaching 25%. Growth affects your planted crops within 32 blocks while online.

traits.name: Seed Saver
traits.description: 10% chance to preserve a planting item after successful planting.

traits.name: Replant
traits.description: Optional mature-crop replanting using one planting item from your inventory.

traits.name: Harvest Pouch
traits.description: Optional crop and seed collection. Overflow stays in the world.

traits.name: Green Thumb
traits.description: 15% chance to preserve bone meal when it advances a supported crop.

traits.name: Light Footed
traits.description: Your footsteps cannot trample farmland.

traits.name: Seed Saver II
traits.description: Planting-item preservation increases to 25%.

traits.name: Master Farmer
traits.description: Optional sneak-harvest with a hoe: up to nine mature crops in a 3 by 3 area.

traits.name: Harvestmaster title
traits.description: Unlock the Harvestmaster chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Mining
description: Mine faster, find hidden ores and unlock spells for bigger excavations.
training: Use a pickaxe to mine natural stone and ores.
Rarer ores give more experience. Blocks placed by players do not count.
rules: Silk Touch cannot double ores. Fortune works normally, and its drops can then be doubled.
Prospector chimes toward your chosen ore within 12 blocks.
Master Miner breaks up to 12 connected natural ores of the same type. It cannot bypass protection.

traits.name: Careful Hands
traits.description: 10% chance to preserve mining durability; 20% at level 75.

traits.name: Deep Pockets
traits.description: Toggle automatic collection. Overflow drops normally.

traits.name: Steady Footing
traits.description: Removes the airborne mining penalty; underwater penalties remain.

traits.name: Veinsight
traits.description: Spell Menu: 3 runes reveal nearby natural ores privately.

traits.name: Prospector
traits.description: Select an ore in the journal for a quiet directional chime within 12 blocks.

traits.name: Demolition Training
traits.description: 25% less damage from TNT and TNT minecarts, regardless of owner.

traits.name: Earthshatter I
traits.description: Spell Menu: 5 runes excavate a 3×3×3 tunnel. Territory and protection checks apply.

traits.name: Careful Hands II
traits.description: 20% chance to preserve mining durability.

traits.name: Earthshatter II
traits.description: Upgrade Earthshatter to a 3×3×10 tunnel for 10 runes.

traits.name: Master Miner
traits.description: Enable Master Miner, then sneak-mine up to 12 connected matching natural ores per activation. Normal drops, durability and protection apply.

traits.name: Earthshaper title
traits.description: Unlock the Earthshaper chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Woodcutting
description: Save tool durability, replant saplings and learn to fell whole trees.
training: Use an axe to harvest logs and stems from trees or nether fungi. Trees grown from your own saplings count too.
Placed or stripped logs, leaves, decorative wood, bamboo and mushrooms do not train Woodcutting.
rules: Replant uses saplings from your inventory after you finish harvesting a recognized tree.
Canopy Care makes sapling and apple drops 50% more likely, rather than adding a flat 50% chance.
Unusual or oversized trees may need manual chopping. Nether fungi must be replanted by hand.

traits.name: Chopping Speed
traits.description: Up to +50% speed across ordinary levels.

traits.name: Timber Yield
traits.description: Up to 25% chance to double a normal wood drop across ordinary levels.

traits.name: Steady Axe
traits.description: 10% chance to preserve axe durability on eligible logs.

traits.name: Replant
traits.description: Toggle automatic replanting from your inventory after a complete tree harvest.

traits.name: Lumber Pouch
traits.description: Toggle automatic collection; overflow stays on the ground.

traits.name: Verdant Surge
traits.description: Spell Menu: 3 runes advance sapling growth along a 20-block wave.

traits.name: Canopy Care
traits.description: Harvested trees have 50% higher sapling and apple drop chances. No shears or Silk Touch.

traits.name: Seed Keeper
traits.description: Replant has a 25% chance to preserve each required sapling.

traits.name: Gale Cleave
traits.description: Spell Menu: 10 runes harvest up to three trees or 64 harvestable tree blocks, including supported giant mushrooms.

traits.name: Steady Axe II
traits.description: Durability preservation increases to 20%.

traits.name: Fleeceweave
traits.description: Spell Menu: 10 runes permanently turn a targeted tree or giant mushroom into matching wool. No wood drops or Woodcutting XP.

traits.name: Master Lumberjack
traits.description: Enable Master Lumberjack, then sneak-chop up to 32 logs of one confirmed tree per activation. Normal durability and protection apply.

traits.name: Grovewarden title
traits.description: Unlock the Grovewarden chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Fishing
description: Wait less, recover missed bites and catch rare trophies.
training: Cast your rod and reel in successful catches to level up.
Bonus fish, treasure and trophies do not give extra experience.
rules: Leveling reduces your wait for bites. Lure and normal fishing conditions still matter.
Trophies and treasure upgrades need open water. Trophies take priority over treasure and bonus fish.
Tackle Pouch sends catches to your inventory. If it’s full, they drop normally.

traits.name: Patient Angler
traits.description: Up to 25% shorter base waiting time across ordinary levels.

traits.name: Careful Cast
traits.description: 10% chance to preserve rod durability when landing a catch.

traits.name: Tackle Pouch
traits.description: Toggle direct catch collection; inventory overflow stays in the world.

traits.name: Fresh Catch
traits.description: 10% chance to double an ordinary fish. Treasure and trophies are never doubled.

traits.name: Trophy Angler
traits.description: An ordinary open-water fish can become a rare trophy (2% default chance), recording its species, size and catcher.

traits.name: Second Chance
traits.description: A missed bite has a 25% chance to return once per cast, marked by a chime.

traits.name: Treasure Hunter
traits.description: An ordinary open-water fish has a 2% upgrade roll for vanilla treasure after no trophy was selected.

traits.name: Master Angler
traits.description: Open-water ordinary catches gain a 0.5% legendary-trophy chance and a 4% rare-trophy chance. These outcomes replace the fish.

traits.name: Angler title
traits.description: Unlock the Angler chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Magic
description: Cast water and fire spells. Level up to improve mana regeneration, damage and healing.
training: Use staff spells to damage enemy mobs.
Healing, utility spells, peaceful creatures, other players and Creative mode do not train Magic.
rules: Right-click a staff to cast. Sneak + swap hands changes spells; with an offhand staff, use sneak + right-click. Equip only one staff at a time.
Each cast uses one Magic Rune plus mana. Craft 1 flint and 1 lapis lazuli into 8 runes. Right-click a rune for the Spell Menu.
You have 100 mana. It starts refilling three seconds after casting. Leveling improves regeneration, damage, burns and healing—not spell duration or terrain effects.
Downpour needs no skill level: spend 1 rune to water exposed farmland and put out fires along a 20-block path. Wait 10 seconds between casts.
Mining, Woodcutting and Construction spells unlock through those skills. Protection and combat restrictions still apply.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +5% mana regeneration and +0% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Water Bolt
traits.description: Water Staff: a traveling bolt with a brief slow. 10 mana; 1.5-second shared cooldown.

traits.name: Tidal Surge
traits.description: Water Staff: a wave that slows, pushes and extinguishes. 30 mana; 10-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +5% mana regeneration and +5% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +10% mana regeneration and +5% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Healing Spring
traits.description: Water Staff: a ten-second pool that heals players and peaceful creatures. 40 mana; 25-second cooldown.

traits.name: Whirlpool
traits.description: Water Staff: target ground to pull enemies into a six-second swirling pool. 45 mana; 20-second cooldown.

traits.name: Ember Bolt
traits.description: Fire Staff: a traveling bolt of flame. 10 mana; 1.5-second shared cooldown.

traits.name: Featherbound
traits.description: Spell Menu: 2 runes, 20-second cooldown. Jump or begin falling within three seconds for one enhanced jump/slow fall; ends on landing, never halfway through a fall.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +10% mana regeneration and +10% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Firestorm
traits.description: Fire Staff: rain fire over a targeted area. 45 mana; 15-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +15% mana regeneration and +10% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Inferno Nova
traits.description: Fire Staff: an expanding close-range blast with four seconds of burn. 35 mana; 12-second cooldown.

traits.name: Superheat
traits.description: Spell Menu: 3 runes, 45-second cooldown. Double one furnace, blast furnace, smoker or lit campfire’s processing speed for 30 seconds.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +15% mana regeneration and +15% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Flame Lance
traits.description: Fire Staff: charge for 0.75 seconds, then spear up to three targets across 24 blocks. Carries targets and can pin them against walls; four-second burn. 40 mana; 12-second cooldown.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +20% mana regeneration and +15% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +20% mana regeneration and +20% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +25% mana regeneration and +20% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Arcane Attunement
traits.description: +25% mana regeneration and +25% spell damage and healing. Bonuses are additive, not compounded.

traits.name: Wizard title
traits.description: Unlock the Wizard chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.

name: Construction
tagline: Build a place worth returning to.
description: Build and craft to gain reach, teleport home and build as a flying spirit.
training: Build with new materials, craft building items and furniture, or use a stonecutter.
Complete each Hearthstone stage for the first time, and build your first Inn and Stable, for bonus experience.
Breaking and replacing blocks does not count. Reclaimed materials stay ineligible, even after crafting or processing. Creative mode does not train Construction.
rules: Builder’s Reach extends block placement while you hold building materials. It does not extend mining or attack range.
Home bonuses work only in your own territory. Hunger perks save food but do not refill it.
Right-click a Magic Rune for spells. Bedbound and Hearthward need three seconds standing still and share a five-minute cooldown. Wait 15 seconds after combat to cast.
Personal Chest opens your 27-slot Ender Chest. Your items stay saved across worlds and restarts.
Astral Projection lets you fly and build in your territory, but not attack. Your body stays vulnerable; damage hurts you and ends the spell. Press Shift+F to return, or stay as long as you like.
Creative abilities need an administrator to enable them. Level, rune and combat rules still apply.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +0.5 blocks of global placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Bedbound
traits.description: 2 runes: return beside your active bed after a three-second stationary channel.

traits.name: Hearthward
traits.description: 3 runes: return to the top of your Hearthstone’s gold heart after a three-second stationary channel.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +1 blocks of global placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Personal Chest
traits.description: 1 rune: open your private 27-slot chest from any world. No cooldown; unavailable during combat or Astral Projection.

traits.name: Comforts of Home
traits.description: 50% less hunger and saturation drain from exhaustion in your own territory.

traits.name: Astral Projection
traits.description: 4 runes: leave your vulnerable body to fly and build within your territory. No time limit; Shift+F returns. Three-second channel and three-minute casting cooldown.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +1.5 blocks of global placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Builder’s Stride
traits.description: 10% movement speed while holding building materials in your own territory and out of combat.

traits.name: Well Provisioned
traits.description: 100% less hunger drain in your own territory. Does not refill food; exhaustion carried in from outside can still consume existing saturation.

traits.name: Builder’s Reach
traits.description: +2 blocks of global placement reach while holding building materials.

traits.name: Master Architect
traits.description: Construction spells cost one fewer rune, with a minimum cost of one.

traits.name: Architect title
traits.description: Unlock the Architect chat title. Select it in Hearthstone → Titles.
